items.titleZh: 劳森重返红牛首日排位表现意味深长
items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位中仅落后队友维斯塔潘0.365秒，虽在SQ2遭淘汰，但其回归红牛首日的状态明显好于去年的短暂效力期。

media.altZh: 劳森重返红牛首日排位表现意味深长

items.originalTitle: 劳森重返红牛首日表现意味深长
items.summaryEn: Liam Lawson lapped just 0.365s behind team-mate Max Verstappen in sprint qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix, and although he was eliminated in SQ2, he looked far more comfortable with the Red Bull than during his troubled two-event stint last year.
detailZh: 对于劳森来说，在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中仅比队友维斯塔潘慢0.365秒——这本是一个相当不错的成绩——却令他感到沮丧，这很能说明问题。
Lawson仅进行了一次自由练习，再加上一天模拟器训练，他驾驶红牛赛车的适应程度看起来明显好于去年他在F1车队那段波折的两站比赛期间的任何时候——但即便这个差距远小于去年他三次与Verstappen同场排位赛中最好一次的差距，也未能完全反映他的真实速度。
Lawson在SQ2中被淘汰，将在明天的冲刺赛中从第11位发车，这令人非常失望，因为这与之前的表现不相符。他在该节的两次快圈之后通过无线电明确表达了这一点，说“我不知道Q2发生了什么”。下车后他也没能给出更清楚的解释。
“说实话，我真的不知道，”Lawson谈到SQ2中出现的问题时说。“这是很有意思的一天，但通常你在排位赛中会不断进步，我们在SQ1开局相当强势，但之后没有像其他所有人那样取得同样的进步。显然我们会去研究这个问题，今天有很多需要学习的地方，但到目前为止我在赛车里的感觉相当好。说实话，整个排位赛过程中我感觉还不错，我以为我们能晋级，所以很遗憾。”
在赛车里感觉“舒服”才是最重要的。在自由练习赛中，你可以看到他在3号弯（有坡度的弯道）旁观看时相对放松。是的，他在攻击这个弯角时比队友马克斯·维斯塔潘更为保守，这也是可以预料的，但劳森至少看起来对赛车掌控自如。
主要的问题在于，他在练习赛末尾的两个快速圈中跑宽，导致赛车底板蹭过了出弯路肩。
我上次近距离观看他驾驶红牛赛车是在去年的中国大奖赛上，当时他在那场最终被证明是他（直到现在之前）为车队出战的最后一站比赛里显得完全无所适从。在那场比赛中，他小心翼翼，第一个飞驰圈就冲进了砂石区，而且始终没能适应赛车，但在这里他看起来完全不是那样。今天他不可避免地没有达到维斯塔潘的水平，但考虑到具体情况，这是一个良好的开端。
同样的情况也适用于第一节排位赛（SQ1）。他的三个飞驰圈中第一个很慢，但那是因为圈上遇到了交通状况。他的最后两个飞驰圈则更有说服力，让他以比维斯塔潘快0.165秒的成绩排名第六，结束了排位赛的第一阶段。
这提升了人们对SQ2的期待，因为即使在红牛车队陷入困境的一天，Lawson看起来也有进入前十的速度。所以最终错失晋级，而且只比接替他通常座驾的车手角田裕毅快了千分之几秒，这对他来说无疑是一个打击。

随着赛道条件的变化而调整是排位赛的技巧之一，但对于一位对赛车还不熟悉的车手来说，没有掌握这一点是可以理解的。SQ1末尾就提醒了这一点，当他回到车库时，他提到了小红牛通常使用的前翼襟翼角度。他报告说自己对平衡感到满意，由于无线电对外界静音，目前还不清楚红牛最终朝哪个方向调整，但随着赛道抓地力提升，理解赛车对增加一点前翼下压力会有什么反应，这需要通过熟悉赛车来积累经验。考虑到Lawson缺乏这种经验，今天的情况如何发展对周末剩余时间来说是个好兆头。
“确实是这样，”Lawson说。“我们显然会努力解决这个问题，并在排位赛中把它整合起来。但我们今天确实有潜力排在很靠前的位置，所以这很令人沮丧。”
重要的是，综合考虑之下，这对Lawson来说是一个好的开始。而这比去年发生的情况要好得多。
detailEn: For Liam Lawson to be frustrated after lapping a respectable 0.365s off team-mate Max Verstappen in sprint qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix is revealing.

With just one free practice and a day in the simulator under his belt, Lawson looks significantly more comfortable with the Red Bull than he did at any point in his troubled two-event stint with the Formula 1 team last year - but even a margin well under half the deficit of the best of his three qualifying outings alongside Verstappen last year didn't do his underlying pace justice.

Lawson's elimination in SQ2, leaving him 11th on the grid for tomorrow’s sprint race, was so disappointing given it was out of kilter with what came before. He made that clear over the radio after the second of his two quick laps in that session, saying “I’ve no idea what happened in Q2”. He didn't have a clearer explanation after he got out of the car.

“Honestly, I don’t really know,” said Lawson of what went wrong in SQ2. “It's been an interesting day, but normally you'd improve through quali and we started SQ1 quite strong and then we didn't make the same step that everybody else did. Obviously we'll look into it, there's a lot to learn today, but so far I feel quite good in the car. I was honestly feeling OK through quali, I thought we'd get through, so it's a shame.”

Feeling “OK” in the car is what matters. You could see he was relatively at ease watching trackside in free practice at the banked Turn 3. Yes, he was a little more conservative than team-mate Max Verstappen in how he attacked the corner, as you would expect, but Lawson at least looked like he was on top of the machinery.
The main concern was that two of his quick laps at the end of the session resulted in him running wide and dragging the floor of the car across the exit kerb.

The last time I watched him in a Red Bull up close was in China last year, where he looked all at sea on what proved to be his final outing - until now - for the team. There, he was tentative, taking a trip through the gravel on his first push lap and never getting to grips with it, but here he looked nothing like that. He was not at Verstappen’s level today, inevitably, but in the circumstances it was a good start.

The same applies to SQ1. The first of his three push laps was slow, but that was down to traffic on the lap. His final two efforts were much more convincing, allowing him to end the first segment of qualifying 0.165s ahead of Verstappen in sixth place.

This raised expectations for SQ2, as even on a day when Red Bull was struggling Lawson appeared to have the pace to make the top 10. So to miss out, and only be a few thousandths ahead of the man who took over his usual car, Yuki Tsunoda, was understandably a blow.

Moving with the evolving track is one of the skills of qualifying, but it’s excusable not to have mastery of it for a driver who is unfamiliar with the car. There was a reminder of that at the end of SQ1, when he returned to the garage and referenced what Racing Bulls normally does with the front wing flap angle. He reported he was happy with the balance, and it’s not clear what direction Red Bull went in because the radio feed fell silent to the outside world, but understanding how a car might react to adding in a little more front wing as the track grip improves is something that comes with experience of the machinery. Given Lawson lacks that, the way today played out bodes well for the rest of the weekend.
“It definitely does,” said Lawson. “We'll obviously try and fix it and put it together for quali. But we definitely had the potential to be right up there today, so it's frustrating.”
What matters is that this was, all things considered, a good start for Lawson. And that's much better than what happened last year.
keyPointsZh: 劳森在SQ2遭淘汰，将以第11位发车参加明天的冲刺赛。
他在无线电中表示“我不知道Q2发生了什么”，并表示SQ1状态很强但未能像其他车手那样提升。
他此前仅有一节自由练习和一天模拟器经验。
keyPointsEn: Lawson was eliminated in SQ2 and will start tomorrow's sprint race from 11th on the grid.
He said over the radio "I've no idea what happened in Q2" and noted they were strong in SQ1 but didn't make the same step as everyone else.
He came into the weekend with only one free practice session and a day in the simulator.

items.titleZh: 塞恩斯赞德福特练习赛砂石路受损，正接受调查
items.summaryZh: 卡洛斯·塞恩斯在赞德福特大奖赛练习赛中因多次驶过“激进”的砂石路导致赛车部件受损，被迫使用竞争力较差的部件，并在冲刺赛排位赛后因涉嫌“不必要慢速行驶”接受调查。

items.originalTitle: 萨因茨赛车因赞德福特练习赛“激进”砂石路受损
items.summaryEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr sustained damage to his car after going off into the "aggressive" gravel multiple times during practice for the Dutch Grand Prix, forcing him to revert to less competitive components, and he is under investigation for potentially driving unnecessarily slowly in sprint qualifying.
detailZh: 小卡洛斯·塞恩斯表示，在荷兰大奖赛练习赛中受损后，他不得不换回竞争力较差的部件。
他还暗示，威廉姆斯车队在准备于阿塞拜疆大奖赛为赛车引入重大升级时，备件库存已经不多。塞恩斯在第一次练习赛中三次冲出赛道，打乱了他为今天的冲刺赛排位赛所做的准备。
“今天早上我在赛车的平衡方面遇到了很大困难，不幸的是几次冲进了砂石区，”塞恩斯说。“我们损坏了赛车上相当多的部件，所以在我的第一次练习赛中，我无法使用正确的部件，而我们在本周末剩余时间里必须装到车上的部件，在下压力和性能输出方面都不是最好的。”
“但事实就是这样。在巴库获得升级之前，我们在所有方面都有点紧张，不幸的是这条赛道的砂石路相当激进，会损坏赛车上相当多的部件。所以我们会努力在冲刺赛中尽可能多地学习，然后应对本周末剩余的比赛。”
尽管如此，塞恩斯对他在冲刺赛排位赛中的表现感到满意，最终他在发车格上排名第18。“显然SQ1的关键在于前两圈，”他说，“而我在第一次练习赛中没能获得正确的认知，所以并不是说我能做出两个非常好的圈速，因为最终你会因为从第一次练习赛中缺乏了解而吃亏。”
“但考虑到我跑的圈数很少，而且我的赛车状况很受影响，我认为我做出了几个不错的圈速。”
排位赛后，赛会干事宣布塞恩斯因在排位赛期间可能“不必要地慢速行驶”而接受调查。
塞恩斯的队友亚历山大·阿尔本证实，车队车手们必须小心，以免耗尽备用部件库存。“显然我们使用这些赛车已经有一段时间了，我们有一段时间没有升级了，所以它们有点磨损，我们必须好好对待它们。”
detailEn: Carlos Sainz Jnr says he has had to revert to less competitive components after sustaining damage during practice for the Dutch Grand Prix.

He also indicated Williams are running low on their stock of parts as they prepare to introduce a major upgrade for their car at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Sainz went off three times during the first practice session which disrupted his preparations for today’s sprint race qualifying session.

“I struggled a lot this morning with the balance of the car and unfortunately went off into the gravel a few times,” said Sainz. “We damaged quite a lot of parts on the car, so in my FP1 I couldn’t run with the right components and the components that we have to put on the car for the rest of the weekend are not the best in terms of downforce and performance delivery.

“But it’s what it is. We are a bit tight on everything until we get the upgrade in Baku and unfortunately the gravel in in this track is quite aggressive and it breaks quite a lot of parts of the car. So we’ll try and learn as much as possible in the sprint and we’ll take the rest of the weekend.”

Nonetheless Sainz was pleased with his effort in qualifying for the sprint race, which left him 18th on the grid. “Obviously SQ1 is all about the first two laps,” he said, “and I didn’t get a proper read in FP1 so it’s not like I could do two very good laps because in the end you’re suffering with the lack of knowledge that you carry from FP1.
“But given how little I ran and how compromised my car is, I think I did a couple of good laps.”
After the qualifying the stewards announced Sainz is under investigation for potentially “driving unnecessarily slowly” during the session.

Sainz’s team mate Alexander Albon confirmed the team’s drivers are having to take care not to deplete their stack of spare parts. “We’ve obviously had these cars for a while now, we haven’t upgraded for a while, so they’re a little bit worse for wear, so we have to treat them nicely.”
keyPointsZh: 塞恩斯在第一次练习赛中三次冲出赛道，打乱了冲刺赛排位赛的准备工作。
威廉姆斯车队因等待阿塞拜疆大奖赛的重大升级，目前备件库存紧张。
队友亚历山大·阿尔本确认车手们必须小心驾驶以避免耗尽备件。
keyPointsEn: Sainz went off three times during the first practice session, disrupting his preparations for sprint qualifying.
Williams are running low on spare parts as they prepare to introduce a major upgrade at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Teammate Alexander Albon confirmed the drivers must take care not to deplete their stock of spare parts.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli：F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛失误损失“25点下压力”
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli revealed that his Turn 13 off during Dutch Grand Prix sprint qualifying cost him roughly "25 points of downforce", leaving him fifth on the grid for Saturday's 24-lap sprint race.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利：F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛冲出赛道导致损失"约25点下压力"
积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛的第一个飞驰圈于13号弯冲入了砂石区
基米·安东内利透露，在荷兰大奖赛的冲刺赛排位赛中，他在13号弯的失误造成了大约"25点下压力"的损失。此前他为周六的24圈F1比赛排位第五名。
这位积分榜领跑者在冲刺赛排位赛第一阶段率先出场，圈速一度快于队友拉塞尔，但在倒数第二个弯角遭遇了突然的转向过度，修正动作最终让他冲出了赛道，进入了砂石区。
值得称赞的是，安东内利能够让车头保持正确方向并重新回到赛道，但那一圈早已作废，在该阶段的比赛中他只排到第八，在第一段排位赛（SQ1）中落后勒克莱尔的基准成绩近0.7秒。
虽然这位意大利车手在冲刺排位赛中有所恢复，并在第三段排位赛（SQ3）中将赛车放在第五位，但他比拉塞尔慢了超过0.2秒。保守估计，损失的25点下压力带来的影响大约是半秒的差距，不过安东内利表示车队已经能够修复部分底板，以恢复底板产生的一部分负载。
"我的底板上有几个洞，"安东内利告诉天空体育F1。"所以我进站的时候，他们最初说损失了25点。然后他们尽量进行了修复，但是是的，损伤肯定还在。"
"我在低速弯里非常挣扎，但就是这样。在第一段排位赛的那一圈，我在最后一个弯的入弯速度稍微快了一点，失去了车尾，冲进了砂石区。就是这样。"
“而且显然，重建信心也不容易，但还是相当接近了。明天我们会再试一次。”
梅赛德斯的负责人托托·沃尔夫表示，损失大约是20分而不是25分，但他也承认，安东内利的失误造成了“相当大的打击”。
安东内利将从第三排发车参加冲刺赛，排在他前面的有拉塞尔，以及两辆迈凯伦——两辆迈凯伦之间由勒克莱尔的法拉利隔开。冲刺赛排位赛中前四名车手的最后一圈成绩都在十分之一秒之内，显示出2026年三支顶尖车队之间竞争的激烈程度。
他表示，再加上赞德沃特赛道紧凑且技术性强的特点，想要争取胜利会很困难——但至少在冲刺赛结束后停放规则解除后，他将有机会在完整的排位赛中使用一块新的底板。
“我们会尽力跑出最好的比赛。当然，前方车距非常接近，所以超车不会很容易，”安东内利补充道。
“但我们会尽全力做到最好，即使带着损伤。然后在排位赛（qualifying）中，我们会把赛车调校好，重新再来。希望明天运气更好。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli: F1 Dutch GP sprint qualifying off cost "25 points of downforce"
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli went into the gravel at Turn 13 on his first flying lap of Dutch GP sprint qualifying

Kimi Antonelli has revealed that his Turn 13 off during the Dutch Grand Prix's sprint qualifying session had cost approximately "25 points of downforce", after qualifying fifth for Saturday's 24-lap Formula 1 race.

The championship leader opened the first stage of sprint qualifying and was running faster than team-mate George Russell, but faced a snap of oversteer through the penultimate corner and the correction ended up putting him into the gravel.

Antonelli, to his credit, was able to keep the car facing the right way and rejoined the track, but that lap had long since faded away and he only managed eighth in that phase of the session, almost 0.7s off Charles Leclerc's benchmark in SQ1.

While the Italian was able to recover through sprint qualifying and put his car fifth in SQ3, he was over 0.2s down on Russell. A conservative estimate of the impact of the lost 25 points of downforce would come to an approximate half-second loss, although Antonelli stated that the team had been able to repair some of the floor to reinstate some of the load produced by the floor.

"I had a couple of holes in the floor," Antonelli told Sky Sports F1. "So when I came in, they initially said it was a loss of 25 points. Then they tried to repair as much as possible, but yeah, definitely the damage was still there.

"I was struggling a lot in the low speed, but yeah, it's what it is. I had a little bit too much entry speed in the last corner in that lap one and lost the rear and went through the gravel. And yeah, that was pretty much it.
"And then obviously also was not easy to build the confidence back, but still, decently close. And we'll have another go tomorrow."
Mercedes chief Toto Wolff suggested that it was around a 20-point loss, rather than 25, but agreed it was "quite a big hit" with Antonelli's error.

Antonelli will start the sprint race on the third row, behind Russell, and both McLarens - who were split by Leclerc's Ferrari. The final laps of the top four drivers in sprint qualifying were all within a tenth of a second, demonstrating the closeness of 2026's top three teams.

He says that this, allied to the tight and technical nature attributed to the Zandvoort circuit, will make it difficult to attempt to secure victory - but will at least have the opportunity to run with a new floor in full qualifying once parc ferme reopens post-sprint.
"We'll try to do the best race we can. Of course it's very close at the front, so it's not going to be easy to overtake," Antonelli added.
"But we'll try to do the best we can, even with the damage. And then from qualifying, we're going to tidy the car up and go again. Better luck tomorrow."

他在倒数第二个弯道遭遇转向过度，修正时冲入砂石缓冲区
keyPointsEn: Antonelli opened the first stage of sprint qualifying and was initially faster than team-mate George Russell

items.summaryZh: F1时隔近一个月的首个正式计时环节在赞德福特结束，冲刺排位赛争夺激烈，《The 比赛》评选出本场的主要赢家与输家。
items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺排位赛赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first competitive session in almost a month at Zandvoort produced a closely fought battle for sprint pole, and The Race has picked out the biggest winners and losers from sprint qualifying.
detailZh: F1时隔近一个月的首个竞技性环节呈现出一场激烈的冲刺赛杆位争夺战，以及一些有趣的车队内部较量。
以下是我们在赞德沃特冲刺赛排位赛中选出的最大赢家和输家。
尽管相对于他在SQ1中的表现，SQ2的结果令人失望，但总的来说，可以说劳森还是守住了自己这一端的承诺。
不过小红牛22在这里看起来确实是第四快的车，而且快到足以让维斯塔潘的第六名可以说是超水平发挥。正如Verstappen自己略带讽刺地说道：“我猜我们排位成绩压过了一辆车。”
他发现自己的红牛赛车比练习赛中更听话，但仍然缺乏他所需要的平衡和抓地力——因此希望寄托在赛车驶出赛后封存区之后能有重大改变。—— Val Khorounzhiy
Tsunoda最终与Arvid Lindblad的圈速差距，与另一支车队中替补车手和正式车手之间的差距相当——但在这里他在“赢家”类别中获得了认可（这并不是说Lawson令人失望）。
考虑到他此前从未驾驶过这类赛车排位，第12名对于驾驶小红牛赛车来说是一个非常扎实的成绩，而且虽然你会认为这里的车友差距因赛道长度而被缩小，但其余的排位赛结果并不能有力地支持这一假设。
再考虑到Lindblad在SQ3中为了榨取更多速度而超越了赛车的极限，这对于Tsunoda赛车履历上这条最新的经历来说是一个非常不错的开端（而不久的将来，这份履历可能会也可能不会包括IndyCar）。—— VK
在练习赛中看似有一个强势的开局（费尔南多·阿隆索排第12位）之后，搭载升级版本田引擎的阿斯顿·马丁首秀却令人失望。
阿隆索最终全场最慢，一次故障意味着他无法使用直道模式，这在2026年是巨大的损失，因为它会破坏赛车的平衡以及单圈中的能量需求。他还抱怨与自己在第一个弯角冲出赛道无关的振动问题，并在新本田引擎的可驾驭性方面遇到了困难。
兰斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁速度更快一些，且直道模式正常工作，但仍距离进入Q2慢了近0.7秒。
这与车队在匈牙利大奖赛周末的出色表现形成鲜明对比，那场比赛本让车队希望在赞德沃特再次争取进入Q2的位置。
最大的问题是，鉴于这—除了亨格罗林拍摄日之外—是它第一次真正接受激烈测试，本田能解决多少这些驾驶性问题。- Josh Suttill
赢家：皮埃尔·加斯利的升级版阿尔派（第8名）
在接连几场比赛中艰难驾驶一辆竞争力日益不足的赛车之后，这看起来更像是加斯利和阿尔派在本赛季初所达到的性能水平。
阿尔派为本次赛事紧急装上加斯利赛车的重大升级套件，包括大幅改进的地板和扩散器，以及新的侧箱和后刹车鼓，看起来非常强大。据阿尔派常务董事Steve Nielson称，它弥补了车队两辆赛车在SQ2中0.719秒差距的大部分。
迈凯伦在匈牙利凭借一次大幅度的底板升级迈出了一大步，而阿尔派似乎在中游集团也做出了类似的改进。这对弗朗哥·科拉平托来说心情复杂，他在SQ1勉强过关，然后在SQ2以第14名出局：一方面，他很高兴看到车队取得重大进步；另一方面，让他沮丧的是，他的赛车要到蒙扎才能用上这一升级。 - 本·安德森
可以说，乔治·拉塞尔是本周末最需要表现出色的车手，而他把这个开局完成得非常完美——他的队友基米·安东内利出现多次失误，而他则在练习赛和排位赛中几乎毫无波折地轻松度过。
“这很好地提醒了我，我依然有实力，还没有忘记怎么开车，”拉塞尔说，他在适应2026年赛车特定要求方面的困难早已广为人知。
“我以真正开放的心态迎接这个周末，因为我完全不知道会怎样，信心水平确实不在我的最高点，”他补充道，但他把这个周末当作赛季首场比赛、不过度纠结的策略为他带来了一个出色的杆位——当时有四辆车的成绩都在十分之一秒之内，而其中没有一辆是他的队友的。 - 杰克·贝尼恩
汉密尔顿在冲刺赛排位赛中的最后一圈看起来确实很不稳定，完全足以解释他与勒克莱尔之间0.6秒的差距——而且他赛后承认这是一个“不顺利的练习赛”。
但他认为这并不是因为失误不断累积，而是因为在练习赛后的“细微调整”之后，SF-26赛车偏离了最佳状态——无论是相关性还是因果关系——这让他突然面对一辆“完全不同的赛车”。
“查尔斯的调校设置和我的稍有不同，所以更接近我之前的状态，”汉密尔顿表示。- VK
安东内利声称损失了25单位的下压力，这肯定能解释他比队友乔治·拉塞尔慢0.2秒的原因。
对于安东内利(Antonelli)来说，这不是从夏休期回归的理想开局，他在自由练习一(FP1)中打转，随后在排位赛第一阶段(SQ1)于12号弯冲出赛道，造成赛车受损。
“那一圈在最后一个弯道的入弯速度有点太快了，我失去了车尾，然后冲进了砂石区，”他解释道，并补充说他的赛车底部出现了破洞，这也打击了他的信心。
当你的队友和对手们都在苦苦挣扎时，这类错误或许可以被掩盖过去，但如果安东内利想避免自己的势头被削弱，他就需要重新展现出顶尖水准的表现。
自摩纳哥站以来，亚历克斯·阿尔本(阿尔本)首次在排位赛中成为威廉姆斯车队更快的车手——而且只快了不到0.15秒。
对Albon来说，目前车手市场并没有迫在眉睫的威胁，因为他刚刚确认明年将继续为威廉姆斯效力，但开始扭转今年与塞恩斯之间极其一边倒的排位赛较量，肯定不会有坏处。
塞恩斯排位赛的困境部分原因在于，他在一练中多次冲出赛道，损坏了他的威廉姆斯赛车，这意味着他不得不换上一些非最优的部件。
用Albon的话说，威廉姆斯目前在部件一致性方面正“与自己内心的心魔作斗争”。
Albon解释道：“关于我们赛车上的部件，就是要确保我们真正从现有的车体、赛车本身中发挥出最好的水平。”
“很明显，这些车我们已经用了一段时间了，也很久没有升级了，所以它们有点磨损。我们必须好好对待它们。”
最终，Albon 在这个周末迄今对这些部件的呵护得到了（有限的）回报。 - JS
霍肯伯格 感到震惊，他在赞德沃特冲刺赛排位赛中比队友 博托莱托 慢了 0.830 秒，而且完全无法解释原因。
“我自己也很惊讶，”他说，并感叹这是“一天中两节截然不同的练习/排位”。
在FP1中，他觉得赛车“感觉非常好”，然后“我在SQ1出场时，感觉完全不同，我再也没有同样的抓地力了”。
霍肯伯格在任何练习环节中都很少比博尔托莱托落后那么多，而且他做出成绩的时间更早，而博尔托莱托还在最后计时段做出了全场最快，所以这个差距令人担忧。——JB
以不到0.1秒之差错过杆位总是令人心碎，但兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里至少可以感到欣慰的是，他们在匈牙利展现的夺冠速度至少在一定程度上延续到了夏休后的首场比赛。
对两位车手来说，问题都出在SQ3换上软胎之后。
detailEn: Formula 1's first competitive session in almost a month delivered a closely fought battle for sprint pole and some interesting intra-team victories.
Below are our picks for the biggest winners and losers from sprint qualifying at Zandvoort.
Despite a disappointing SQ2 outcome relative to what he'd managed in SQ1, it's ultimately fair to say Liam Lawson is holding up his end of the bargain.

But the RB22 does appear fourth-best here, and a fourth-best enough that Max Verstappen's sixth is an arguable overperformance. As Verstappen himself put it, sounding a little sardonic: "I guess we outqualified one car."

He found his Red Bull more compliant than in practice but still not with the balance and grip that he needs - so the hopes rest on a significant change when the cars come out of parc ferme. - Val Khorounzhiy

Tsunoda ended up with a similar laptime deficit to Arvid Lindblad as the equivalent in the sister team between the stand-in and full-timer - but gets the nod in the 'winner' category here (which is not to say Lawson disappointed).

Considering he has never qualified one of these cars before, 12th is a rock-solid return in the Racing Bulls car, and while you'd think the team-mate gaps here are diminished by the track length, the rest of the qualifying results do not overwhelmingly support that hypothesis.

Consider also that Lindblad went beyond the limits of the car trying to squeeze out more in SQ3, and this is a very good start for this latest line on Tsunoda's racing CV (that may or may not include IndyCar not so far down the line). - VK
After what appeared to be a strong start in practice (Fernando Alonso was 12th), the debut of the upgraded Honda engine aboard the Aston Martin was a disappointment.

Alonso ended up slowest of all with a failure that meant he couldn’t use straight mode, a huge loss in 2026 as it upsets the balance of the car and the energy requirements around the lap. He also complained of vibrations unrelated to his off at the first corner and struggled with the drivability of the new Honda engine.
The quicker Aston Martin of Lance Stroll, whose straight mode was working, was still nearly seven tenths from making it into Q2.
It’s a big contrast to the team’s promising Hungarian GP weekend, which will have given the team hopes of fighting for a place in Q2 again at Zandvoort.
The big question is how many of those driveability problems Honda can iron out, given this - Hungaroring filming day aside - is the first day it’s properly been tested in anger. - Josh Suttill
Winner: Pierre Gasly’s upgraded Alpine (8th)
After several races of toiling in an increasingly uncompetitive car, this looked much more like the level of performance Gasly and Alpine were achieving at the very start of the season.

The substantial upgrade Alpine has fast-tracked onto Gasly’s car for this event, featuring a substantially revised floor and diffuser, as well as new sidepods and rear brake drums, looks extremely powerful and, according to Alpine managing director Steve Nielson, was worth most of the 0.719s gap between the team’s two cars in SQ2.

McLaren made a huge step with a substantial floor upgrade for Hungary, and it seems Alpine has done something similar in the midfield here. That means mixed feelings for Franco Colapinto, who barely scraped through SQ1 and was out in SQ2 in 14th: on the one hand, he's delighted to see the team take a big step forward; on the other, he's frustrated his car won’t get to take that step until Monza. - Ben Anderson

You could argue George Russell was the driver who most needed to excel this weekend, and he’s started that off perfectly with his team-mate Kimi Antonelli making multiple errors as he cruised through practice and qualifying almost without incident.
“It's good to remind myself I still got it and haven't forgotten how to drive,” stated Russell, whose difficulty in adapting to the specific demands of the 2026 cars is well documented.

“I came into this weekend with a real open mind because I had no idea how it was going to go, confidence level wasn't exactly at my highest,” he added, but his strategy of treating this weekend like the first race iof the season and not overthinking it led to an excellent pole where he clearly made the difference as four cars were within a tenth of a second - and none were his team-mate. - Jack Benyon
Hamilton's final push lap in sprint qualifying looked really ropey, easily ropey enough to account for a six-tenths gap to Leclerc - and he admitted afterwards it was "not a good session".

But rather than a consequence of errors creeping in, he felt the SF-26 had just got away from its sweet spot after "subtle adjustments" after practice that - correlation or causation - suddenly left him with a "completely different car".
"Charles is in a slightly different place than me [in terms of set-up], so a bit closer to where I was," Hamilton suggested. - VK
Antonelli’s stated loss of 25-points of downforce certainly explains his two-tenth time loss to team-mate George Russell.
It’s not the ideal return from the summer break for Antonelli, who spun in FP1 and then went off at Turn 12 in SQ1, causing damage.

“It was a little bit too much entry speed in the last corner in that lap one and lost the rear and went through the gravel,” he noted, adding he had holes in the floor of his car and it knocked his confidence.

These are the sorts of errors you can get away with when your team-mate and the opposition are floundering, but Antonelli needs to get back to executing at an elite level if he wants to avoid his momentum being eroded.
For the first time since Monaco, Alex Albon was the quicker Williams driver in a qualifying session - and by just under a tenth and a half.

There’s no immediate driver market jeopardy for Albon, given he’s just recommitted to racing for Williams next year, but starting to reverse what’s been an extremely one-sided qualifying battle with Carlos Sainz this year certainly won’t hurt.
Carlos Sainz’s tricky qualifying was partly explained by his multiple off-track moments in FP1 that damaged his Williams, and meant he had to be swapped to some sub-optimal parts.
In Albon’s words, Williams is “struggling with our own demons” with parts consistency right now.
“With the parts on our car, just making sure that we're actually getting the best out of the bodywork, the car itself, that we actually have,” Albon explained.
“We've obviously had these cars for a while now, we haven't upgraded for a while, so they're a little bit worse for wear. We have to treat them nicely.”
Ultimately, Albon’s treated those parts nicer so far this weekend and reaped the (limited) benefits. - JS
A shocked Nico Hulkenberg was 0.830s slower than team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto in Zandvoort sprint qualifying and had nothing in the way of an explanation.
“I’m surprised myself,” he said, lamenting a “a day with two very different sessions”.
In FP1 he thought the car was “feeeling really good” and then “I went out in SQ1, it was a completely different sensation and I just didn't have the same grip anymore”.

Hulkenberg is very seldom that far off Bortoleto in any session, and even as he set his time earlier in the session and Bortoleto managed a session-best final sector, so that time gap is a worry. - JB

To miss out on pole by less than a tenth is always gut-wrenching, but Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri can at least be pleased that their race-winning pace from Hungary has at least somewhat translated to the first race following the summer break.
For both drivers, it went wrong with the switch to the soft tyre for SQ3.

items.titleZh: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势向哈贾尔提出建议
items.summaryZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因上周在健身房训练时手腕受伤，将缺席本周末的荷兰大奖赛；红牛与七届MotoGP世界冠军马克·马尔克斯都建议他不要冒险，安心恢复。

media.altZh: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势向哈贾尔提出建议

items.originalTitle: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势向哈贾尔提出建议
items.summaryEn: Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix after sustaining a wrist injury during a gym session last week, with both Red Bull and seven-time MotoGP world champion Marc Marquez advising him not to take any risks and to focus on recovery.
detailZh: 马尔克斯就手腕伤势给哈贾尔的建议
伊萨克·哈贾尔渴望直接回到赛车中参加荷兰大奖赛，但红牛和马克·马尔克斯都劝他不要冒任何风险
伊萨克·哈贾尔因上周在健身房训练时手腕受伤，将缺席本周末的荷兰大奖赛。据小红牛首席执行官彼得·拜耳透露，红牛姊妹车队于周五得知可能更换车手的消息，情况在周二进一步进展。
当时，角田裕毅被召入——他接到通知时正在希腊的海滩上——而利亚姆·劳森则在2025年中国大奖赛后被下放后，于红牛获得又一次机会。
虽然这一情况自然为两位车手带来了机会，但对哈贾尔来说却极为沮丧，不过他还是在周五上午出现在了赞德沃特围场。
哈贾尔去年在荷兰首次登上F1领奖台，原本计划在今年以一款特别头盔设计俏皮地致敬这一成就。
红牛与马尔克斯意见一致：慢慢恢复
哈贾尔——正如任何运动员都会有的反应——想立刻重新参赛，但他被两个不同的方面建议不要冒任何风险，缺席荷兰大奖赛。
首先，这一信息来自红牛。劳伦特·梅基斯确认，他的车队不想对马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友冒任何风险，后者今年表现得出人意料地好。
哈贾尔原本为这个周末设计了一款特别头盔，灵感来自代尔夫特蓝陶和他去年破损的奖杯
“伊萨克没事，”梅基斯告诉F1官方网站。“我们没有任何理由对他冒险。他本赛季开局非常出色，每次他把这辆车驶出车库，一节接一节、一个周末接一个周末，他都越来越强。”
“我们零风险，我们让他这个周末处理好恢复，希望我们能非常、非常快地让他回到车里。”
建议他跳过赞德沃特的还有另一个更令人意外的来源：七届MotoGP世界冠军马克·马尔克斯。
这位杜卡迪车手与哈贾尔共用同一位理疗师卡洛斯·J·加西亚。哈贾尔在手腕受伤后致电马尔克斯，这位西班牙人建议他不要急于复出。
这位目前在MotoGP积分榜上排名第四的车手还敦促哈贾尔不要急于接受某些医疗程序，因为这位法国人还很年轻，前方还有漫长的F1生涯。
因此马尔克斯认为，慢慢来并妥善恢复对哈贾尔来说是最明智的做法，而这正是红牛已经告诉这位年轻人的。
马尔克斯本人在伤病方面有大量亲身经历。这位MotoGP偶像除其他伤病外，曾右臂和右手拇指骨折、双肩脱臼，并患有复视。
马尔克斯以伤后快速复出而闻名，但他建议哈贾尔反其道而行之
当然，关键问题是哈贾尔何时能够重返小红牛22的驾驶舱。
当被Autosport问及时，红牛表示现在提供官方更新还为时过早，不过计划是让他在两周后的意大利大奖赛上回到车中。
“现在肯定说还为时过早，但我们的目标是让他在蒙扎回归，”梅基斯告诉德国天空体育。
意大利大奖赛将于9月4日至6日的周末举行。尽管蒙扎公园内这条标志性赛道当然不是赛历上对身体要求最高的赛道，但一周后紧接着就是在新马德里赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛。
detailEn: The advice Marquez gave Hadjar over his wrist injury
Isack Hadjar was eager to get straight back in the car for the Dutch GP, but both Red Bull and Marc Marquez urged him not to take any risks

Isack Hadjar misses this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix after sustaining a wrist injury during a gym session last week. According to Racing Bulls CEO Peter Bayer, Red Bull’s sister team was informed on Friday of a potential driver change, with the situation developing further on Tuesday.

That was when Yuki Tsunoda was called up – having been on a beach in Greece when he was asked to step in – while Liam Lawson was handed another opportunity at Red Bull following his demotion after the 2025 Chinese Grand Prix.
While the situation naturally presents opportunities for both drivers, it is highly frustrating for Hadjar, who nevertheless made an appearance in the Zandvoort paddock on Friday morning.
Hadjar claimed his maiden F1 podium in the Netherlands last year and had planned to reference that achievement with a playful nod in a special helmet design this year.
Red Bull and Marquez in agreement: Take your time to recover
Hadjar – as you might expect from any athlete – wanted to go racing again straight away, but he has been advised by two different parties not to take any risks and to sit out the Dutch GP.
First of all, that message came from Red Bull. Laurent Mekies confirmed that his team did not want to take any risks with Max Verstappen's team-mate, who has performed surprisingly well this year.
Hadjar had planned a special helmet design for this weekend, inspired by Delft blue pottery and his broken trophy from last year

"Isack is alright," Mekies told the official F1 website. "We have no reason to take any risk with him. He has done a fantastic start of the season, he has been stronger and stronger every time he has been driving this car out of the garage, session after session, weekend after weekend.

这位法国F1车手原本急于立刻回到赛车中参加荷兰大奖赛，但红牛车队和这位MotoGP明星都敦促他不要冒任何风险
伊萨克·哈贾尔因上周在健身房训练中手腕受伤，将错过本周末的荷兰大奖赛。据小红牛首席执行官彼得·拜耳透露，红牛的姊妹车队在周五就被告知可能会有车手变动，情况在周二进一步发展。
正是在那时，角田裕毅接到召唤——当时他正在希腊的海滩上，被要求替补出场——而利亚姆·劳森在2025年中国大奖赛后被降级，如今在红牛又获得了另一次机会。
虽然这种情况自然为两位车手都带来了机会，但对哈贾尔来说却极其令人沮丧，不过他周五上午还是出现在了赞德沃特的车队围场。
哈贾尔去年在荷兰站拿到了自己的首个一级方程式领奖台，他原本计划在今年用一款特制的头盔设计，以俏皮的方式致敬那一成就。

哈贾尔——正如人们在一项运动员身上所能预期的那样——本想立刻重返赛场，但两方都建议他不要冒任何风险，缺席荷兰大奖赛这个周末。
首先，这条消息来自红牛。劳朗·梅基斯确认，车队不想在维斯塔潘的队友身上冒任何风险，这位车手今年表现惊人地出色。
"伊萨克没有问题，"梅基斯对F1官方网站表示。
"我们没有任何理由在他身上冒险。他这个赛季的开局非常出色，每次把这台车开出车库时，他都在不断变强，一个赛段接一个赛段，一个周末接一个周末。
"我们零冒险，让他这个周末好好休养恢复，希望我们能让他非常、非常快地回到车里。"
哈贾尔原本为本周末计划了一款特别的头盔设计，灵感来自代尔夫特蓝陶和他去年摔碎的奖杯。
跳过赞德沃特的建议还来自另一个更令人意外的来源：七届MotoGP冠军马克·马尔克斯。
这位杜卡迪车手与哈贾尔共用同一位理疗师卡洛斯·J·加西亚。哈贾尔在手腕受伤后给马尔克斯打了电话，这位西班牙人建议他不要急于复出。
这位目前在MotoGP积分榜上排名第四的车手还敦促哈贾尔不要急于进行某些医疗程序，因为这位法国人还很年轻，F1职业生涯还很漫长。
因此，马奎兹认为，对哈德贾尔来说，慢慢来、好好恢复才是最明智的做法，而这正是红牛早已经告诉这位年轻车手的话。
马奎兹本人在伤病方面有着丰富的亲身经历。这位MotoGP传奇人物曾摔断过右上臂和右手拇指，双肩都曾脱臼，还遭受过复视的困扰。
马奎兹以伤后快速复出而闻名，但他却建议哈德贾尔反其道而行之
当然，关键问题在于哈德贾尔何时能够重新坐进小红牛22的驾驶舱。
当Motorsport.com进行询问时，红牛表示，现在就此提供官方消息还为时过早，尽管计划是让他在两周后的蒙扎重回赛车。

意大利大奖赛将于9月4日至6日的周末举行。虽然蒙扎公园里这座标志性赛道绝对不是赛历上对身体要求最高的赛道，但一周之后紧接着就是在新马德林赛道举办的马德里大奖赛。

items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索在冲刺赛排位赛中遭遇引擎和空气动力学问题，最终在冲刺赛发车格上排名最后。他在赛后表示：“当你刹车时油门还开着，很难让赛车停下来。”

detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索在赞德沃特的冲刺赛中将从最后一位发车，因为他在升级后的阿斯顿·马丁赛车上遇到了多个问题。
在本周末的比赛前，车队寄予厚望，因为本田为其动力单元带来了今年的首次升级。但在荷兰大奖赛的首次练习赛中排名第12后，阿隆索在冲刺赛排位赛中跌至第22位。
他说他在排位赛中遇到了“各种各样的小问题”。
“自由练习还算可以，但在排位赛中我们的引擎出了问题，驾驶性在刹车时推头。有时候很难让赛车停下来，因为我认为引擎输出过度了。”
“而且显然直线模式（SLM）对我没起作用，所以我无法打开尾翼。所以两者的结合让圈速非常棘手。”
阿隆索在排位赛初段因引擎问题在Tarzan弯冲出赛道。“当你刹车时油门还开着，很难让赛车停下来，”他说。
他的排位赛成绩比队友兰斯·斯特罗尔慢0.6秒，并以近1.4秒之差无缘第二节排位赛。
然而，他对车队在充分发挥最新升级潜力后的前景仍持积极态度。
“自由练习感觉还行，我觉得有进步，”他说。“我认为现在还很早，可能所有控制等方面都还有点不成熟。”
“这是一个冲刺赛周末：在正常周末我们有三次练习来完善套件，显然在冲刺赛中我们需要在今天的排位赛中应对情况，明天的冲刺赛中我们也会尝试理解一些东西。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso will start last on the grid for the sprint race at Zandvoort after encountering multiple problems in his upgraded Aston Martin.

The team’s hopes were high for this weekend’s race after Honda brought its first upgrade for its power unit this year. But having been 12th in the opening practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix, Alonso fell to 22nd in qualifying for the sprint race.
He said he had problems with “a little bit of everything in qualifying.”

“The free practice was more or less okay but in qualifying we had problems on the engine, driveability was pushing on the braking. It was difficult to stop the car sometimes because the engine I think was over delivering
“And then apparently the SLM [straight-line mode] didn’t work for me so I could not open the rear wing So a combination of both made the laps very tricky.”
Alonso went off at Tarzan early on in the session as he struggled with the engine. “When you brake and the throttle is open, it is difficult to stop the car,” he said.
He qualified six tenths of a second slower than team mate Lance Stroll and missed the cut for the second stage of qualifying by almost 1.4 seconds.
However he remains positive about the team’s potential once it gets the best out of its latest upgrades.
“Free practice felt okay and I felt a step forward,” he said. “I think it’s very early days and probably it’s a little bit immature with all the controls, et cetera.

“It’s a sprint weekend: on a normal weekend we have three practices to nail the package, obviously on a sprint we need to deal with the situation in today’s qualifying and tomorrow on the sprint race we’ll try to understand also a few things.”

items.summaryZh: 在赞德福特举行的F1冲刺赛排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以1分11秒567的成绩夺得本赛季个人第三个冲刺赛杆位，前四名车手之间的差距不到0.1秒。
items.originalTitle: 拉塞尔力压安东内利夺得荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛杆位
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell took his third sprint pole of the season in F1 sprint qualifying at Zandvoort, where the top four drivers were separated by less than a tenth of a second.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在赞德沃特F1冲刺赛排位赛中为梅赛德斯夺得个人本赛季第三个冲刺赛杆位，前四名车手的差距不到0.1秒。
拉塞尔在积分上落后队友基米·安东内利50分，但他在这里跑出了1分11.567秒的单圈——尽管中间计时段相对较慢——当时全场车手都换上软胎进行单圈冲刺杆位争夺战。
“戴上订婚戒指后车应该轻了一点吧，”拉塞尔打趣道，暗指他最近向伴侣求婚一事。
兰多·诺里斯驾驶搭载尾翼端板褶皱状百叶窗升级件的迈凯伦，成为SQ3车手中第一个做出像样飞驰圈的人，而迈凯伦是唯一有两辆车进入前四的车队，皮亚斯特里位列第四。
诺里斯仅比拉塞尔慢0.041秒，而夏尔·勒克莱尔领跑法拉利阵营，仅比梅赛德斯的标杆时间慢0.055秒。
基米·安东内利在练习赛中打转，并在SQ1的12号弯冲出赛道，最终只能排名第五，比拉塞尔慢了超过十分之二秒。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在SQ1中因可能阻挡了刘易斯·汉密尔顿而被赛会记录在案，但很快被解除调查，他最终排名第六，慢了超过半秒；而刘易斯·汉密尔顿则因1号弯的一次突然转向过度和9号弯入弯困难而受到影响，最终排名第七。
经过升级的阿尔派让皮埃尔·加斯利重新回到中游集团的领先位置——这是车队本赛季前半段的常态，随后才被升级后的小红牛超越——而奥迪的加布里埃尔·博托莱托实际上排在了小红牛中排名最高的阿尔维德·林德布拉德之前。
升上红牛一队的劳森在本场比赛中顶替受伤的哈贾尔驾驶红牛赛车，他在SQ1中惊人地击败了Verstappen，但在SQ2情况却截然不同。
红牛青训体系的竞争是如此残酷，小红牛车队的Arvid Lindblad一定会为自己在所谓B车队中将Lawson挡在SQ2之外而感到无比高兴。
“我不知道发生了什么，”Lawson说，他似乎一直受转向不足困扰，最终排在第11位，成为SQ2中第一个被淘汰的车。
“来吧，伙计们，干得好！”是Lindblad发出的信息。
从积极的一面来看，抛开被林德布拉德（Lindblad）击败的背景，劳森（Lawson）在冲刺赛排位赛中仅落后维斯塔潘（Verstpapen）十分之三多一点，对于他第一次驾驶这辆红牛赛车来说，这是一个不错的结果。
角田裕毅落后队友林德布拉德（Lindblad）十分之三，尽管他今天才代替劳森（Lawson）首次体验2026年的赛车，参加本周末的比赛。
弗朗哥·科拉平托（科拉平托）很受打击，他的阿尔派队友加斯利（Gasly）的升级版赛车顺利进入第三节排位赛（SQ3），而他却只能接受第13名，排在尼克·霍肯伯格（霍肯伯格）之前——后者可能因为在本节较早时候做出了最快圈速而受损，落后队友博托莱托（Bortoleto）十分之八。
埃斯特班·奥康（奥康）和亚历克斯·阿尔本（阿尔本）分别获得第15和第16名，分别是哈斯和威廉姆斯车手中成绩最好的……
奥利·贝尔曼和卡洛斯·塞恩斯在2026年的排位赛中都曾碾压过自己的队友，但在赞德沃特站的冲刺排位赛中，两人都被各自的搭档击败，止步于SQ1，分别排在第17和第18位。
奥康和阿尔本在最后时刻做出的成绩提升，把各自的队友压在了身后，为两人所在的车队在后夏休期赛季的开局迎来良好开端。
阿斯顿·马丁在匈牙利站取得的巨大进步并未在赞德沃特重演——兰斯·斯托尔排第18，费尔南多·阿隆索垫底，并抱怨直道上存在振动，而且“不是来自轮胎，对吧？”。他的直道模式尾翼设置也失灵了。
由新任车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基本周末首次带领的凯迪拉克车队，成绩夹在两辆阿斯顿·马丁之间，瓦尔特利·博塔斯排第20，领先于塞尔希奥·佩雷斯。
detailEn: George Russell claimed his third sprint pole of the season for Mercedes in a Zandvoort Formula 1 sprint qualifying where the top four were split by less than a tenth of a second.

Russell trails team-mate Kimi Antonelli by 50 points, but nailed a 1m11.567s lap here - despite a relatively slow middle sector - as the field switched to soft tyres for the one-lap sprint pole shootout.
“Must be a bit lighter after the engagement ring,” joked Russell, alluding to his recent proposal to his partner.

Lando Norris was the first to set a proper flying lap of the SQ3 runners with the upgraded McLaren that has crinkle-cut louvres on its rear-wing endplate, and McLaren was the only team to have two cars in the top four with Piastri in fourth.
Norris was just 0.041s off Russell, while Charles Leclerc led the Ferrari charge just 0.055s off the Mercedes benchmark.
Kimi Antonelli spun in practice and went off at Turn 12 in SQ1, and could only manage fifth and over two tenths off Russell in the final pole shootout.

Max Verstappen, who was noted but soon cleared by stewards for potentially impeding Lewis Hamilton in SQ1, was sixth and over half a second off the pace, while a snap of oversteer at Turn 1 and a struggle to turn in at Turn 9 hampered Lewis Hamilton in seventh.

The upgraded Alpine propelled Pierre Gasly back to the front of the midfield where it lived for the first part of the season before the upgraded Racing Bulls took over, with Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto actually ahead of the top Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad.
The promoted Liam Lawson had staggeringly beaten Verstappen in SQ1, having taken over the injured Isack Hadjar’s Red Bull for this race, but it was a different story in SQ2.
Such is the cut-throat nature of Red Bull’s junior programme, Racing Bulls’ Arvid Lindblad will be absolutely delighted that he relegated Lawson out of SQ2 in the so-called B-team.
“I have no idea what happened,” said Lawson, who appeared to be struggling with understeer, and ended up 11th and the first car out of SQ2.
“Come on, boys, well done!” was Lindblad’s message.

On the plus side, taking the context of being beaten by Lindblad out of it, being just over three tenths off Verstappen in sprint qualifying is a decent result for Lawson's first time in this Red Bull car.
Yuki Tsunoda was three tenths off team-mate Lindblad, despite just getting his first taste of a 2026 car today in place of Lawson for this weekend.

Franco Colapinto suffered as his Alpine team-mate Gasly’s upgraded car sailed into SQ3 while he had to settle for 13th, ahead of Nico Hulkenberg - who perhaps suffered from setting his best lap earlier in the session, eight-tenths off stablemate Bortoleto.
Esteban Ocon and Alex Albon managed 15th and 16th as the top Haas and Williams respectively…
Ollie Bearman and Carlos Sainz have both hammered their team-mates in 2026 qualifying, but were both beaten by their partners and out in SQ1 here in Zandvoort, landing in 17th and 18th respectively.
Late improvements from Ocon and Albon helped relegate their respective team-mates in a great start to the post-summer-break season for both.

Aston Martin’s massive step for Hungary was not replicated in Zandvoort - with Lance Stroll 18th and Fernando Alonso dead last complaining of vibrations on the straight, and “not from the tyres, eh?”. His straight mode rear wing setting was also not working.
The Cadillacs, led by new team boss Marcin Budkowski for the first time this weekend, split the Aston Martins, with Valtteri Bottas 20th ahead of Sergio Perez.

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：拉塞尔在激烈的冲刺赛排位赛中夺杆，安东内利第五
正在努力挽救自己F1 2026赛季争冠希望的乔治·拉塞尔，在赞德福特夺得个人本赛季第三个冲刺赛杆位
乔治·拉塞尔夺得了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛的杆位，而F1锦标赛领跑者基米·安东内利仅排在第五位。
这位梅赛德斯车手仅以0.041秒的优势压过卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，拿下个人2026赛季的第三个冲刺赛杆位。
拉塞尔的杆位尤其出人意料，因为他在SQ1和SQ2中均未占据榜首——这两个阶段分别由查尔斯·勒克莱尔和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里领跑——但他在最后一节跑出的1分11秒567已经足够。
最后一节的争夺也非常激烈，获得第三的勒克莱尔为法拉利出战，仅落后0.055秒，而诺里斯的迈凯伦队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位列第四，落后拉塞尔0.099秒。
随后与拉塞尔的队友安东内利之间的差距稍大一些，他落后这位英国车手0.227秒，并因SQ1在倒数第二个弯道冲出赛道而底板受损。
安东内利之后恰好落后0.3秒的是红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘，位列第六，领先第七名的刘易斯·汉密尔顿一个位置，后者在另一辆法拉利中表现挣扎，落后拉塞尔0.624秒。
阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利、奥迪的加布里埃尔·博托莱托和小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林德布拉德分别占据赞德福特前十的其余席位，之后将进行周六的缩短赛程比赛。
对于顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔的利亚姆·劳森来说，这是一次体面的红牛回归，他在被通常的队友林德布拉德淘汰后，排位第11。
“我不知道发生了什么，”这位新西兰人表示，他落后SQ3四成，将与他的小红牛替补、F1回归者角田裕毅共享第六排。
弗朗哥·科拉平托将排在第13位，位于第七排，与第14名的尼科·霍肯伯格同排，而埃斯特班·奥康和亚历克斯·阿尔本分别位列SQ2淘汰区的末尾。
在SQ1中，奥利弗·贝尔曼的晚段提升让他升至第17位，比威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯高一个位置，后者被贝尔曼的哈斯队友奥康挤入淘汰区。
最后四个位置由常见面孔占据：阿斯顿·马丁的兰斯·斯特罗尔第19，凯迪拉克二人组瓦尔特利·博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯第20和第21，费尔南多·阿隆索第22。
阿隆索尤其挣扎，他在1号弯锁死，尽管有凯迪拉克的尾流仍排名最后，随后确认他的尾翼直线模式未能工作。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Russell takes pole in tight sprint qualifying with Antonelli fifth
George Russell, who is trying to save his F1 2026 title bid, took his third sprint pole of the season at Zandvoort
George Russell has taken pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race with Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli down in fifth.
The Mercedes driver pipped reigning world champion Lando Norris by only 0.041s to take his third sprint pole of the 2026 season.
Russell’s pole came particularly out of the blue after topping neither SQ1 or SQ2 - respectively done by Charles Leclerc and Oscar Piastri - but a 1m11.567s in the final session was enough.
It was a very tight final session too, as third-placed Leclerc was just 0.055s off the pace for Ferrari with Norris’ McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri in fourth and 0.099s behind Russell.
A slightly bigger gap then emerged to Russell’s team-mate Antonelli though, who was 0.227s behind the Briton and suffering floor damage from an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
Precisely three tenths behind Antonelli was Red Bull’s Max Verstappen in sixth, one spot ahead of seventh-placed Lewis Hamilton who struggled in the sister Ferrari with a 0.624s gap to Russell.
Alpine’s Pierre Gasly, Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto and Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad respectively rounded out the top 10 at Zandvoort ahead of Saturday’s shortened race.
It was a respectable Red Bull return for Liam Lawson, who has replaced the injured Isack Hadjar, as he qualified 11th after being eliminated by his usual team-mate Lindblad.
“I have no idea what happened,” reported the New Zealander, who was four tenths off SQ3, and will share the sixth row with his Racing Bulls stand-in and F1 returnee Yuki Tsunoda.
Franco Colapinto will be on the seventh row in 13th, shared with 14th-placed Nico Hulkenberg, while Esteban Ocon and Alex Albon respectively rounded out the SQ2 drop zone.
In SQ1 a late improvement from Oliver Bearman put him 17th and one spot above Williams man Carlos Sainz, who was pushed into the elimination zone by Bearman’s Haas team-mate Ocon.
The last four spots were occupied by the usual suspects: Aston Martin’s Lance Stroll in 19th, Cadillac duo Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez 20th and 21st and Fernando Alonso in 22nd.
Alonso particularly struggled as he locked up at Turn 1 and finished last despite a tow from a Cadillac and it was later confirmed that the Straight Line Mode on his rear wing didn’t work.

安东内利落后拉塞尔0.227秒，因SQ1在倒数第二个弯道冲出赛道导致底板受损。
维斯塔潘第六，汉密尔顿第七，落后拉塞尔0.624秒。

Antonelli was 0.227s behind Russell and suffered floor damage from an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
Verstappen was sixth and Hamilton seventh, 0.624s behind Russell.
